scope: Four whole-card candidates with rules evidence; not whole-set acceptance
independent_final_head_reviews: required before integration; coordinated by integrator

printed_obligations.oracle: Choose up to two. Return those cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Whenever you draw a card, if you control another Hero, Human Torch deals 1 damage to target opponent.
Power-up — {6}{R}: Put three +1/+1 counters on Human Torch. (Activate each power-up ability only once. Reduce the cost by his mana cost if he entered this turn.)
When Killmonger enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
As long as there are two or more creature cards in your graveyard, Killmonger gets +2/+1.
{3}, {T}: Mill four cards. You may put a Hero or enchantment card from among those cards into your hand. (To mill four cards, put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)

new_shared_rule.behavior: Retain independently revalidated bound targets across all groups, deduplicate their exact ObjectRefs, and use one central simultaneous movement transaction. Existing ReturnToHand behavior is unchanged.
current_consumers: Call Damage Control, six two-category modes
new_shared_rule.xmage_difference: Pinned Java gives each selected target category a separate return effect. Oracle has a single return-those-cards instruction: returning two distinct cards must produce one graveyard departure batch, demonstrated by the existing Spirit Mascot one-or-more trigger.

important_interactions.killmonger: Optional non-targeted sacrifice first, separate reflexive target afterward; source departure, replaced sacrifice, own/opponent/nonland restrictions, stale or changed-control targets, creature tokens, live graveyard threshold under control transfer and ability loss.
important_interactions.rick: Actual tap and mana payment, summoning sickness, four/short/empty libraries, Hero-or-enchantment disjunction, Rest in Peace first-public-destination exile recovery, optional decline, frozen controller after source change/departure, exact membership/generation/ownership and hidden-object rejection.
important_interactions.torch: Each individual card draw, intervening-if at event and resolution, opponent targets, source departure and changed control, paid Daydream blink with High Fae Trickster permission; reentered Torch is another Hero for an old queued packet. Power-up entry discount, full later cost, once-per-incarnation use and counter replacement.
important_interactions.call: All eleven combinations including zero, mandatory own-graveyard category targets, artifact-creature occupying both groups, exact incarnation binding and partial/all target illegality, known returned hand cards with unrelated hand/library privacy, one observer trigger for two simultaneous returns.

test_method.owned_replay: Every checked action tests wrong-actor atomicity, a child branch after disposing its parent, indexed-vs-raw equality, restore and stale revision rejection. Explicit reject helper verifies illegal-action snapshot and revision atomicity.
test_method.fixture_boundaries: Some adversarial source departure, controller transfer, stale-incarnation and hidden-destination transitions are direct scenario fixture mutations between real paid actions. Paid Daydream/High Fae Trickster and Harmless Offering separately exercise real blink/control paths.

limitations: Full release validation and two final published-head independent nonauthor reviews remain integration requirements.
All 281-card complete gameplay, full games and performance acceptance remain open.
No simulation benchmark was run in this card batch.
The inherited Agent Phil Coulson noncreature Kindred-Hero narrowing remains tracked separately; this batch does not change it.

Arnim Zola needs an activation-time own-graveyard creature-count guard; Doctor Doom needs artifact-AND-creature counting rather than an OR kind mask, plus an audited Doombot recipe. Those cards and other audited missing-core candidates remain gated.

throughput.scope: Branch creation through authored definitions, source audit, native and Clippy validation, including shared-slot waiting; preceding read-only candidate triage is excluded. Candidates require independent final-head reviews and integration.
throughput.simulation_benchmark: not run; no full-set or all-Standard performance claim

authoritative_notes.scope: Human Torch intervening-if checks and Killmonger separate reflexive targeting; Call Damage Control has no card-specific exception in these notes.
